articles.title: What Does It Mean to Age Well? Three Experts Weigh In
articles.summary: When people tell Dr. Dean Ornish they want to live longer, he asks them why. Maybe they want to dance at their kid’s wedding, they say, or finally write the book they’ve been thinking about for years. Whatever their answer, it gives them something to work toward and can make changing a habit today feel worth the effort. articles.title: Why the BAAJA Permitting Reform Bill Is Dividing Climate and Energy Advocates
articles.summary: The Senate voted on Nov. 18 to move forward with the Bipartisan Affordability and American Jobs Act (BAAJA) of 2026, a controversial permitting reform bill that aims to speed up the nation’s ability to build infrastructure and energy —which can often take years under the current process. articles.title: The True Story Behind The Altruists and the FTX Scandal
articles.summary: Like other entries in the growing genre of media about tech scandals and leadership crises, Netflix’s The Altruists asks how honest a visionary billionaire can be. Shows like The Dropout (in which Amanda Seyfried plays Elizabeth Holmes ) and films like Artificial (starring Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman) imagine a more unrehearsed side of figures audiences have spent much time watching in the public eye, with viewers’ curiosity piqued by controversy and internal politics at their respective companies.
